title: Best Sunscreen (2026)
summary: The guide highlights five face sunscreens that consistently appear across multiple reviews, with EltaMD UV Clear topping the list for its broad‑spectrum protection and lightweight feel.
method: Selected products were chosen from Consumer Reports, CNET, Treeline Review, and Camille Styles, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one source and noting their highlighted strengths.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

products.name: Supergoop! Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40
why: CNET lists it as the best facial sunscreen for all skin tones.
It is fragrance‑free and has no white cast.
products.desc: Supergoop Unseen Sunscreen is a fragrance‑free, no‑white‑cast formula that works for all skin tones.
products.benefit: Picture a makeup artist who needs a sunscreen that won’t interfere with foundation. Supergoop Unseen provides a clear, invisible finish and broad‑spectrum protection, making it easier to layer under makeup. It is the only product in this guide that is specifically noted for working on all skin tones. The catch: it is not as hydrating as other formulas.
products.amazon_listing: Supergoop! Unseen Sunscreen Face Stick SPF 40, Clear, Broad Spectrum 0.7 oz

products.name: Neutrogena Ultra Sheer Face Liquid Mineral Sunscreen SPF 70
why: CNET lists it as the best drugstore facial sunscreen under $20.
It contains vitamin E and is lightweight.
products.desc: Neutrogena Ultra Sheer is a lightweight, vitamin‑E‑infused mineral sunscreen with SPF 70 and no white cast.
products.benefit: Picture a college student on a budget who needs a high‑SPF sunscreen that feels light. Neutrogena Ultra Sheer offers SPF 70, is fragrance‑free, and stays lightweight, making it a practical choice for daily use. It stands out in this guide for its high SPF and affordability. The catch: it does not contain any hydrating ingredients.

products.name: Coola Classic Face Sunscreen SPF 50
why: Treeline Review names it the top pick and best overall for face sunscreens.
It is lightweight and offers reliable performance.
products.desc: Coola Classic Face Sunscreen is a lightweight mineral sunscreen with SPF 50 that provides reliable broad‑spectrum protection.
products.benefit: Picture a traveler who needs a sunscreen that stays comfortable in hot climates. Coola Classic delivers SPF 50, is lightweight, and offers reliable performance across the year. It is the only mineral formula highlighted as best overall in this guide. The catch: it may leave a slight white cast on very dark skin tones.
cons: May leave white cast on dark skin
products.best_for: Travelers and those preferring mineral sunscreens

products.name: P20 Original Sun Cream Spray SPF50+
why: P20 is listed as the best body sunscreen overall in The Independent’s 2026 roundup.
It offers broad‑spectrum SPF50+ and a spray format that users find convenient.
products.desc: P20 Original Sun Cream Spray SPF50+ is a spray sunscreen that provides broad‑spectrum protection with SPF50+. It is lightweight and does not leave a white cast.
products.benefit: Picture a day at the beach where you need a quick, non‑greasy spray that stays on skin. P20 delivers broad‑spectrum SPF50+ and a lightweight feel, making it ideal for active outdoor use. It outperforms other picks in this guide by offering the highest SPF in a spray format, while still avoiding a white cast. The catch: it may not provide as much moisture as lotion‑based options.
products.best_for: Active outdoor users who prefer a spray
products.skip_if: You need heavy moisturizing or a lotion texture

products.name: Soltan Protect and Moisturise Suncare Spray SPF30
why: Listed as the best budget body sunscreen in The Independent’s 2026 roundup.
It offers SPF30 protection in a spray form at a low price point.
products.desc: Soltan Protect and Moisturise Suncare Spray SPF30 is a spray sunscreen that provides SPF30 protection and moisturises skin.
products.benefit: Picture a budget‑conscious traveler who wants quick coverage. Soltan delivers SPF30 and a moisturizing spray that feels light on skin. It wins against higher‑priced options by offering good protection at a lower cost, but it has a lower SPF than the top pick. The catch: its SPF is only 30, which may be insufficient for prolonged sun exposure.
products.skip_if: You need high SPF for extended outdoor activity

products.name: Kopari Beauty Sunglaze Sheer Body Mist SPF30
why: Featured as the best Korean body sunscreen in The Independent’s 2026 roundup.
It offers a sheer mist that feels light and is suitable for sensitive skin.
products.desc: Kopari Beauty Sunglaze Sheer Body Mist SPF30 is a mist sunscreen that provides SPF30 protection with a sheer, lightweight feel.
products.benefit: Picture a sensitive‑skin user who prefers a mist that feels airy. Kopari delivers SPF30 in a sheer mist that absorbs quickly and leaves little residue. It competes with other sprays by offering a lighter feel, but its SPF is lower than the top pick. The catch: its SPF is only 30, which may not be enough for heavy sun exposure.
products.best_for: Sensitive‑skin users who want a mist
products.skip_if: You need high SPF for intense sun
